template: e = group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_e}, 63), 4), industry); s = group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_s}, 63), 4), industry); g = group_zscore(winsorize(ts_backfill({factor_g}, 63), 4), industry); e_q = quantile(e, driver="gaussian"); s_q = quantile(s, driver="gaussian"); g_q = quantile(g, driver="gaussian"); min_q = min(min(e_q, s_q), g_q); max_q = max(max(e_q, s_q), g_q); is_balanced = less(subtract(max_q, min_q), 1.0); composite_q = add(add(e_q, s_q), g_q); core = if_else(is_balanced, signed_power(composite_q, 1.5), multiply(-1, signed_power(abs(composite_q), 0.5)))
idea: 高斯分位极化与结构失衡反向映射。先将各维度映射到高斯分布（quantile with gaussian driver）以消除原始分布肥尾影响，然后检查三组分的最大最小分位差。若差异小于1个标准差（均衡状态），则进行1.5次幂变换放大头部优势；若结构失衡（差异大），则对综合得分进行0.5次幂压缩并取负值，将失衡本身转化为做空信号。该模板实现了“均衡则强化，失衡则反转”的非单调逻辑，适用于识别伪装成高ESG的结构性风险敞口。
